html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Did Sir Ving N'Seacressy just tell you to go to Vergrim's Vexation Station and talk to the Undercover Operative there?

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 5

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Did Sir Ving N'Seacressy just tell you to go to Vergrim's Vexation Station and talk to the Undercover Operative there?

Offer:

Let's just, for a second, say that I did get a message from Sir Prize. Then let's go ahead and say that I read this message and learned that there was someone in Vergrim's Vexation Station that can help us in our investigation. If I did those things then I would probably ask you to go and find this person and see what they knew about the situation, or the possibility of a situation, in the Shadow's Embrace.

Why are you still standing here? I said I would probably ask you to go to Vergrim's Vexation Station and then maybe talk to the undercover operative there, if there even is one, and see what you might be able to find out. Not that I'm telling you to actually do that.

*Sir Ving N'Seacressy begins to suffer another agonizing wink-seizure.*

Turn-in:

Oh, hello there. I didn't realize you were trying to talk to me. Most Dungeon Runners ignore me completely. I bet it is my awesome disguise.

Client level range: 45–100
